findings.highlight: The warmth I feel through my eyelids
findings.evidenceJa: 閉じた目蓋ごしに感じる光
findings.governingReading: the light perceived through his closed eyelids
findings.explanation: mirror moon invents warmth and changes the sensory channel that tells Shirou morning has arrived.

findings.highlight: I turn over and look away from the light
findings.evidenceJa: 布団にもぐった体に寝返りをうたせて、陽光から顔を背ける
findings.governingReading: he turns his body beneath the futon and turns his face away from the sunlight
findings.explanation: The English removes Shirou’s body burrowed under the futon and generalizes sunlight into light.

findings.highlight: Judging by the feel of the air
findings.evidenceJa: 外の冷たさからいって
findings.governingReading: judging from the cold outside
findings.explanation: The concrete predawn cold becomes an unspecified atmospheric feeling.

findings.highlight: forced Saber to sleep in the other building
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーを離れの部屋に押し込めて
findings.governingReading: after pushing or confining Saber into a room in the detached wing
findings.explanation: mirror moon adds that Saber was forced to sleep and reduces Shirou’s act of shutting her into the room.

findings.highlight: I don’t know if I can cope with getting only two hours of sleep
findings.evidenceJa: 実質二時間ほどしか睡眠時間がないのはどうかと思う
findings.governingReading: having effectively only about two hours to sleep seems questionable
findings.explanation: A rueful judgment about the schedule becomes doubt about Shirou’s ability to cope.

findings.highlight: It seems something big is by my futon
findings.evidenceJa: 控えめに言って信楽焼の狸ぐらいのものがドーンと鎮座していたような
findings.governingReading: to put it mildly, something about the size of a Shigaraki-ware tanuki seems to be sitting there with an imposing thump
findings.explanation: mirror moon erases the culturally specific size comparison, the statue-like seated posture, and the exaggerated comic impact.

findings.highlight: I feel someone’s presence
findings.evidenceJa: 心なしか人の気配がする
findings.governingReading: he seems, perhaps only faintly, to sense a person’s presence
findings.explanation: A hedged half-awake perception becomes definite.

findings.highlight: as if someone is watching me
findings.evidenceJa: じーっと誰かに見られていて
findings.governingReading: as though someone is staring fixedly at him
findings.explanation: The sustained, unnerving stare becomes generic watching.

findings.highlight: I gave you a separate room
findings.evidenceJa: 離れの部屋に案内した
findings.governingReading: he showed Saber to the room in the detached wing
findings.explanation: The English replaces a precise household location with a merely separate room.

findings.highlight: I leap up from the futon to my feet[line3]no, I stop myself at the last second
findings.evidenceJa: 上半身だけにとどめた
findings.governingReading: he starts to spring from the futon but limits the movement to raising his upper body
findings.explanation: mirror moon first places Shirou on his feet, then claims he stopped; the source explicitly leaves his lower body under the covers.

findings.highlight: I can’t show her my lower half because… um… it’s morning
findings.evidenceJa: 男にだって、その、寝起きは色々ある
findings.governingReading: men, too, have various circumstances upon waking
findings.explanation: The English spells out exposed anatomy that the Japanese deliberately leaves in embarrassed euphemism.

findings.highlight: Still rolled up in my futon, I scramble away
findings.evidenceJa: ごろんごろん、と布団を巻きつけたまま間合いを離す
findings.governingReading: still wrapped in the futon, he rolls over and over to open distance
findings.explanation: mirror moon replaces the visual slapstick of rolling like a bundle with scrambling.

findings.highlight: if she’s sitting by my side when I wake up
findings.evidenceJa: こんな朝っぱらから真横に正座なんてされたら
findings.governingReading: if she sits formally in seiza directly beside him this early in the morning
findings.explanation: The English omits the early hour and Saber’s exact formal posture, both central to Shirou’s comic shock.

findings.highlight: it’s really shocking
findings.evidenceJa: ショックで脳細胞が死ぬ
findings.governingReading: his brain cells will die from the shock
findings.explanation: mirror moon deletes the physiological comic exaggeration.

findings.highlight: If my composure were an army, that would’ve just annihilated it
findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=だいいち char=2]理性小隊が全滅する
findings.governingReading: his “reason platoon,” read with a first-platoon ruby, would have been wiped out
findings.explanation: The English expands the small military unit into an army and loses the reason/First Platoon layered joke.

findings.highlight: I’ll go crazy
findings.evidenceJa: 精神が崩壊してしまう
findings.governingReading: his mental stability will collapse
findings.explanation: A total comic collapse is reduced to a casual English cliché.

findings.highlight: we should distance ourselves
findings.evidenceJa: そのあたりの距離感ってものを
findings.governingReading: they need an appropriate sense of interpersonal distance in such matters
findings.explanation: mirror moon turns negotiated boundaries into the broader proposal that the pair separate themselves.

findings.highlight: I have school today
findings.evidenceJa: 今日から学校じゃないか
findings.governingReading: school starts again from today
findings.explanation: The English removes the change in routine beginning that day.

findings.highlight: I have noticed that you make that face whenever you are about to suggest something foolish
findings.evidenceJa: 決まってよくない提案をすると把握しています
findings.governingReading: Saber understands that whenever Shirou makes that face, he invariably proposes something bad
findings.explanation: Established pattern knowledge becomes casual noticing, while “bad” or unwelcome proposals are editorialized as foolish.

findings.highlight: Her previous aura of loyalty is gone
findings.evidenceJa: さっきまでの忠義はどっかいって
findings.governingReading: the loyalty she showed until just now has gone somewhere
findings.explanation: mirror moon adds an “aura,” making concrete conduct sound like a perceived atmosphere.

findings.highlight: I kneel and face her
findings.evidenceJa: こっちも正座をして向き合う
findings.governingReading: Shirou also sits in seiza and faces her
findings.explanation: A formal seated posture becomes kneeling.

findings.highlight: she’ll approve of me going to school
findings.evidenceJa: 学校のことを納得してもらえる
findings.governingReading: get Saber to understand and accept the matter of school
findings.explanation: mirror moon narrows the coming explanation into a request for permission and supplies the unstated action of going.
